name: blast-undercharge
description: Chapter 5: Charge at the minimum viable boomite amount (2kg) to produce a couple of oversized fragments with zero projections

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:5 depth:6 start:15,15
steps.description: Two increment clicks on the spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raise it 3->5m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts) before dragging, so the (15,15)-(20,20) rectangle computes the declared 2x2 instead of the default-spacing 3x3 (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4). depth corrected from 8 to 6 (Ground rule #15/Finding #42's class, the whole-suite audit before Phase 3): this step never clicks the grid tool's depth stepper (data-field="depth"), so the real drag always produces the panel's own 6m default regardless of what's declared. This file's own expect blocks only assert hole/charge/sequence counts around the affected blast (depth-insensitive), so this is a metadata-only correction -- verified both modes still pass unchanged. #553: confirming the grid queues 4 drill_hole PendingActions and pushes 4 PlannedHoles into plannedDrillHoles — none are drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm.

expect.note: 2 rows x 2 cols = 4 holes ordered (ghosts), none drilled yet (#553)

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes well inside this pad (observed landing at tick 88, sandbox-measured).

expect.note: All 4 holes have landed — none lost, none left ordered forever.

steps.description: stemming:2 already matches the Charge panel's default (DEFAULT_STEMMING_M, Charge.ts), so only amount needs adjusting: 3 decrement clicks on the amount stepper (data-field="amount") reach boomite's minimum viable charge, 5->2kg, before Charge All (issue #479 follow-up, same class as Finding #4/the overcharge fix — verified against the real chargesByHole dump, not assumed).
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero
